description: Switch between publishing every change immediately (auto) and collecting changes on a preview until the user releases them (manual). Explain the consequence before switching to manual: from then on nothing reaches their visitors until they say so, which is the point but also a way to wonder for days why a change never appeared. Switching back to auto publishes whatever was waiting, immediately.

mode.description: auto = live at once, manual = release first

name: runzero_set_publish_mode
title: Set publish mode
